{{External|rs|rsc=Anchovie Pizza}} {{Infobox Item |version1 = Full |version2 = Half |name1 = Anchovy pizza |name2 = 1/2 anchovy pizza |image1 = [[File:Anchovy pizza.png]] |image2 = [[File:1-2 anchovy pizza.png]] |release = [[11 June]] [[2001]] |update = New fishing skill and more cooking |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |edible = Yes |options = Eat, Drop |examine1 = A pizza with anchovies. |examine2 = Half of this anchovy pizza has been eaten. |value1 = 60 |value2 = 30 |weight1 = 0.900 |weight2 = 0.450 |exchange1 = Yes |exchange2 = No |id1 = 2297 |id2 = 2299 }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Anchovy pizza detail.png|left|130px]] |version2 = [[File:1-2 anchovy pizza detail.png|left|110px]] }} '''Anchovy pizza''' is a type of [[pizza]] that restores 18 [[Hitpoints]] in total, 2 bites each healing for 9. It can be obtained by using [[anchovies]] on a [[plain pizza]], requiring 55 [[Cooking]] and granting 39 experience. Anchovy pizzas are the highest healing food per slot in [[free-to-play]] and are also a type of [[Food/Fast foods|fast food]]. Pizza halves can be attached together to remake a full pizza. ==Cooking== {{Recipe |skill1 = Cooking |skill1lvl = 55 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 39 |members = No |ticks = 2 |mat1 = Plain pizza |mat2 = Anchovies |output1 = Anchovy pizza }} {{Instructions |step1 = Use a [[pot of flour]] with either a [[bucket of water]], [[bowl of water]], or [[jug of water]] to create a [[pizza base]] |step2 = Add a [[tomato]] to the [[pizza base]] to create an [[incomplete pizza]] |step3 = Add a [[cheese]] to the [[incomplete pizza]] to create an [[uncooked pizza]] |step4 = Use the [[uncooked pizza]] on a [[range]] to create a [[plain pizza]] (or, if burnt, a [[burnt pizza]]) |step5 = Use [[anchovies]] on the [[plain pizza]] to make an anchovy pizza }} ==Money making== {{Mmgsection|Making anchovy pizzas}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Anchovy pizza}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 13 August 2015 |update = Zoom & The Herb Sack |poll = Old School Content Poll 35: The Max Cape |change = Pizza will now remain in the same inventory slot after the first half is eaten. }} {{Subject changes |date = 26 February 2015 |update = The Grand Exchange |change = The half eaten version was made untradeable on the [[Trading Post]]/[[Grand Exchange]]. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 3 September 2014
- 14 April 2015 |poll = Old School feature poll - Content Poll 24 |change = Pizza halves can be combined to create a full pizza. }} {{Subject changes |date = 6 June 2006 |update = Pest Control update |change = The half eaten version was renamed back from "1/2 anchovie{{sic}} pizza" to "1/2 anchovy pizza". }} {{Subject changes |date = 22 May 2006 |update = Royal Trouble |change = *The half eaten version was renamed from "1/2 anchovy pizza" to "1/2 anchovie{{sic}} pizza". *The half eaten version's examine was changed from "''Half of this pizza has been eaten.''" to "''Half of this anchovy pizza has been eaten.''" }} {{Subject changes footer}} {{Pizza}} [[Category:Food]] [[Category:Needs skilling success chart]]
